sn55.43:3.1: {Saṅghe} || || Paññavā hoti udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammādukkhakkhaya gāminiyā || ayaṃ catuttho puññābhisando kusalābhisando sukhassāhāro || || Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro- -sukhassāhārā || ||
sn55.43:4.1: Imehi kho bhikkhave- -na sukaraṃ gaṇetuṃ- -mahapuññakkhandho teva saṅkhaṃ gacchatī ti || || Idam avoca Bhagavā || ||
sn55.43:5.1: Yo puññakāmo kusale patiṭṭhito || bhāveti maggam amatassa pattiyā || so dhammasārādhigamo khaye rato || na vedhati maccurāja gamissatī
